abstract: The excretion pattern of human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) or luteinizing hormone (LH) was observed in the urine of 77 patients with trophoblastic neoplasia, 109 with complete remission from trophoblastic neoplasia, and 94 with no trophoblastic neoplasia, when the anti-beta-subunit hCG system radioimmunoassay (anti-beta-subunit RIA), which specifically measured hCG was used. The sensitivity of anti-beta-subunit RIA was limited to urinary hCG 16 mIL/ml from the specificity of the anti-beta-subunit serum. Luteinizing hormone in the urine of patients with complete remission and in normal menstrual, postmenopausal, and castrated women was less than 16 mIU/ml in most cases. The excretion pattern of urinary hCG in the patients undergoing treatment for trophoblastic neoplasia was more clearly comprehended with the anti-beta-subunit RIA as compared with the anti-hCH RIA. The criteria for judgment of complete remission were that the hCG value dropped to less than 16 mIU/ml and that cellular response was not observed at least in the last two courses.
abstract_ja: 絨毛性腫瘍の患者77例、完全寛解の患者109例、そして絨毛性腫瘍のない94例の尿中で、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)または黄体形成ホルモン(LH)の排泄パターンを観察した。hCGを特異的に測定する抗βサブユニットhCG系の放射免疫測定法(抗βサブユニットRIA)を用いた。抗βサブユニット血清の特異性から、抗βサブユニットRIAの感度は尿中hCG 16mIU/mlに限られた。完全寛解の患者、および正常な月経周期の女性、閉経後の女性、去勢された女性の尿中の黄体形成ホルモンは、ほとんどの場合16mIU/ml未満であった。絨毛性腫瘍の治療を受けている患者の尿中hCG排泄パターンは、抗hCG RIAと比べて抗βサブユニットRIAによってより明確に把握できた。完全寛解の判定基準は、hCG値が16mIU/ml未満に低下し、少なくとも最後の2コースで細胞学的反応が認められないこととした。
